about: Moving to another country: where to go, which legal route to take (skilled worker, investor, study, family), and life as a migrant (visa renewals, permanent residence, citizenship, visits home, money sent home, bringing parents over). The rules, thresholds and their sources are in MIG in js/engine.js; these cards only ask the questions.

events.src: How often people think of moving is a game rule (ESTIMATE). The routes and their requirements: MIG in js/engine.js.

en..x: A school friend moved abroad years ago and loves it. You catch yourself wondering whether you could build a life in another country. Wages and prices there are no secret; getting in is the hard part.
en..stay.s: Your family, your friends, your language.

zh..x: 一位老同学多年前移居海外，过得很好。你忍不住想：自己能不能在另一个国家重新开始？那里的薪水和物价都查得到，难的是怎么进去。
zh..stay.s: 你的家人、朋友和语言都在这里。

zht..x: 一位老同學多年前移居海外，過得很好。你忍不住想：自己能不能在另一個國家重新開始？那裡的薪水和物價都查得到，難的是怎麼進去。
zht..stay.s: 你的家人、朋友和語言都在這裡。

events.src: Comes up when you choose Move abroad in the Life choices panel (relAct in js/engine.js).

en..x: Pick a country to see what it asks of people moving there.

zh..x: 选一个国家，看看移居那里需要什么条件。

zht..x: 選一個國家，看看移居那裡需要什麼條件。

events.src: The four legal routes, with each country's requirements, fees, waiting times and chances: MIG in js/engine.js (sources there).

en..x: {c} lets people in a few legal ways, each with its own fees and rules. An application takes time, and it can be turned down.

zh..x: {c}有几种合法的移居途径，各有各的费用和条件。申请要花时间，也可能被拒。

zht..x: {c}有幾種合法的移居途徑，各有各的費用和條件。申請要花時間，也可能被拒。

events.src: Work and family permits are renewed every few years; one is refused when its reason is gone (no job, no partner): game rule from the routes in MIG (js/engine.js). The fee is an ESTIMATE.

en..t: Your visa is up for renewal
en..x: Your permit to live in {c} runs out soon. Renewing means forms, fees and proof that the reason you came still holds.
en..leave.s: Let it run out and move back.

zh..x: 你在{c}的居留许可快到期了。续签要填表、交费，还要证明当初来这里的理由仍然成立。

zht..x: 你在{c}的居留許可快到期了。續簽要填表、繳費，還要證明當初來這裡的理由仍然成立。

events.src: Years before permanent residence and the chance of getting it: MIG in js/engine.js. The fee is an ESTIMATE (a US green card application, I-485, is $1,440: USCIS fee rule, 1 Apr 2024).

en..x: You have lived in {c} long enough to apply to stay for good. Permanent residents no longer need their visa renewed.
en..apply.s: Fees about {a}; the answer comes next year.

zh..x: 你在{c}住得够久，可以申请永久居留了。永久居民不用再续签签证。

zht..x: 你在{c}住得夠久，可以申請永久居留了。永久居民不用再續簽簽證。

events.src: Years before citizenship, its chance and whether you may keep your old citizenship: MIG in js/engine.js. The fee is an ESTIMATE (a US N-400 is $760: USCIS fee rule, 1 Apr 2024).

when.test: !!mig && mig.st !== 'cit' && mig.st !== 'student' && mig.citAt <= age && !mig.citApp && !mig.out && (mig.st === 'pr' || MIG[C[mig.d][1]].np != null)

en..x: You can now apply for citizenship of {c}: a test, an oath, and a passport if it goes well.
en..dual: You can keep your old citizenship too.
en..give: You would have to give up your citizenship of {c}.

zh..x: 你现在可以申请{c}国籍了：要考试、宣誓，顺利的话能拿到护照。
zh..dual: 原来的国籍也可以保留。

zht..x: 你現在可以申請{c}國籍了：要考試、宣誓，順利的話能拿到護照。
zht..dual: 原來的國籍也可以保留。

events.src: A return flight home costs about US$1,200 a person (ESTIMATE); closeness and Happiness changes are game rules.

opts.do: spend('mig_visit', f, 'trk.migVisit'); bond('parent', 6); happy += 2; mig.visitAt = age + 2 + Math.floor(roll('visit') * 2)

en..x: It's been a while since you saw {p}. The holidays are coming, and flights back to {c} are filling up.
en..call.s: Free, but it isn't the same.

zh..x: 你好久没见到{p}了。假期快到了，飞回{c}的机票越来越紧。

zht..x: 你好久沒見到{p}了。假期快到了，飛回{c}的機票越來越緊。

events.src: Migrants from poorer countries often send part of their pay home (World Bank, Migration and Development Briefs); the shares offered are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: rec('migRemit', .1 * w, 30); T('migRemit', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.migRemit')}); bond('parent', 8); happy += 1
rec('migRemit', .05 * w, 30); T('migRemit', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.migRemit')}); bond('parent', 4)

en..x: Pay here goes much further back home, and {p} could use the help.
en..p10: Send a tenth of your pay

zh..x: 这里的薪水在家乡很经花，{p}也用得上这份帮助。
zh..p10: 每年寄回薪水的十分之一

zht..x: 這裡的薪水在家鄉很好用，{p}也用得上這份幫助。
zht..p10: 每年寄回薪水的十分之一

events.src: Whether parents can join you, and as what (a permanent resident or a citizen), is MIG.folks in js/engine.js; the fees and the yearly cost of their keep are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: pay(f); rec('migFolks', y, 15); T('migFolks', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.migFolks')}); for (const q of people('parent')) { q.far = 0; q.came = true } bond('parent', 12); happy += 3; mig.folks = 1

en..x: You can now sponsor {p} to come and live near you.
en..bring.s: Fees and flights about {a}, then about {b} a year for their keep.
en..stay.s: They stay where their friends are.

zh..x: 你现在可以担保{p}过来，住在你附近。
zh..bring.s: 费用和机票约{a}，之后每年生活开销约{b}。

zht..x: 你現在可以擔保{p}過來，住在你附近。
zht..bring.s: 費用和機票約{a}，之後每年生活開銷約{b}。
